items.title: Laurence Juber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: So I’m walking into a session and there’s Ernie Watts playing sax in the section

ctx.x: And they called you at Apple.

No, at Abbey Road. Because they tracked me down. But it’s always been this kind of, oh here’s some music, come up with a cool guitar sound, and who’s the artist again? And it just has, over the years, because not just in London but in Los Angeles too. Because when I got to L.A. I got very involved in the studio scene. And not so much on the record side, more on the T.V. and movie side. So I’m walking into a session and there’s Ernie Watts playing sax in the section, or these great drummers that I’ve worked with —…
You became like the second “wrecking crew?”
